attempts.text:
**The window starts on a two-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `lipA` and `tatE`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names them in 99 to 99.8%. Column 2 is variable: `ybeM`, a nitrilase-related carbon-nitrogen hydrolase, named in 85% of calls.

**A long persistent run follows.** Columns 3 to 17, `crcB` to `rnk` through the `cit` genes, [[citrate lyase and its accessory proteins]], sit in 90 to 94% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 4% of calls, named in 96 to 100%. Columns 20 to 23, `uspG` to `dsbG`, are named in 95 to 98%, and columns 25 to 39, `ybdM` to `fepC` through the `ent` and `fep` genes, [[enterobactin synthesis and iron chelate uptake]], in 91 to 99%.

**The first fork is at column 18**, where the model names 66% and hesitates 0.71 bits. Column 47 is a fork: a transposase in 48% of chromosomes, named 57%, 0.91 bits. Columns 48 to 49, `hokE` and `ybdK`, are named 81 to 88%. Columns 52 to 60, `nfsB` to `cusS` through the `cus` genes, [[copper efflux across the membranes]], are named 90 to 98%, but in a region of plasticity in 9 to 88% of calls.

**The window ends in its most hesitant stretch.** Columns 61 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 44 to 93% of calls, named 72 to 93%. Column 63, `fimZ`, is the most hesitant, 1.85 bits, in a region of plasticity in 93% of calls; columns 62 and 64, `ybcH` and `sfmF`, follow at 1.66 and 1.55 bits. A branch of 3 families runs through columns 61 to 63, and a branch of 5 through columns 73 to 77. The window ends at column 79, `ylbE`, in 21% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 1.19 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 96%. Over the whole window it names 92% of genes at 0.40 bits.

label: lipA
facts:
WINDOW: the lipA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor lipA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,104 to 3,183 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying lipA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,280 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 9,601 calls, named 73%, 1.19 bits; cloud 319 calls, named 38%, 2.40 bits. Outside an RGP 34,225 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 8,975 calls, named 78%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 52 spine, 18 fork, 10 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 96%); 8,975 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 63 (fimZ) 1.85 bits, RGP 93%; column 62 (ybcH) 1.66 bits, RGP 92%; column 64 (sfmF) 1.55 bits, RGP 92%. The 16 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.03 bits on average; the other 64 columns: named 95%, 0.25 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 61-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 44-93%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: lipA, tatE. named 99-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 0 (lipA), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.16 bits (column 0 (lipA)).
2. column 2 variable: RGP 0%. named 85%; 0.40 bits.
   2: ybeM S 78% "nitrilase-related carbon-nitrogen h…"
3. columns 3-17 (15 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: crcB, cspE, pagP, dcuC, dpiA "two-component response regulator Dp…", dpiB, citC, citD, citE, citF, citX "citrate lyase holo-[acyl-carrier pr…", citG, citT, rna, rnk. named 96-100% (mean 99%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 5 (pagP), named 96%, 0.41 bits.
4. columns 18-19 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 5%. named 66-90% (mean 78%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18, named 66%, 0.71 bits.
   18 fork: yldA S 61% "small membrane protein YldA"; also yldA (another family) S 26%
   19 variable: ybdR S 64% "alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic dom…"
5. columns 20-23 (4 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 0.4-4%. Genes: uspG, ahpF, ahpC "alkyl hydroperoxide reductase subun…", dsbG. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 21 (ahpF), named 95%; most hesitant at column 23 (dsbG), 0.33 bits.
6. column 24 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 91%; 0.51 bits.
   24: ybdN P 87% "DUF3440 domain-containing protein"
7. columns 25-39 (15 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: ybdM "ParB/RepB/Spo0J family partition pr…", ybdL "methionine-oxo-acid transaminase", hcxA, ybdD "YbdD/YjiX family protein", cstA, entH, entA, entB "enterobactin biosynthesis bifunctio…", entE, entC, fepB, entS, fepD "iron chelate uptake ABC transporter…", fepG, fepC. named 91-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 25 (ybdM), named 91%, 0.46 bits.
8. column 40 variable: RGP 1%. named 97%; 0.25 bits.
   40: wzz(fepE) P 87%
9. columns 41-43 (3 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: entF, ybdZ "enterobactin biosynthesis protein Y…", fes. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 41 (entF), named 95%, 0.31 bits.
10. column 44 variable: RGP 1%. named 94%; 0.16 bits.
   44: fur P 6%
11. columns 45-46 (2 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: fepA, entD. named 83-95% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 46 (entD), named 83%, 0.40 bits.
12. column 47 fork: RGP 9%. named 57%; 0.91 bits.
   47: "transposase" S 48%; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%
13. columns 48-49 (2 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 9%. Genes: hokE, ybdK "YbdK family carboxylate-amine ligase". named 81-88% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 48 (hokE), named 81%, 0.60 bits.
14. columns 50-51 (2 columns) variable: RGP 11%. named 92-96% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 50, named 92%; most hesitant at column 51, 0.45 bits.
   50: ybdJ P 90% "DUF1158 domain-containing protein"
   51: ybdF P 89% "MmcQ/YjbR family DNA-binding protein"
15. columns 52-60 (9 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 9-88%. Genes: nfsB, ybdG "mechanosensitive ion channel YbdG", pheP, cusA "efflux RND transporter permease sub…", cusB, cusF, cusC, cusR, cusS. named 90-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60 (cusS), named 90%, 0.80 bits.
16. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 44-93%. named 72-93% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 63, named 72%, 1.85 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 61-63, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16-35%, all S; the branch's families: tssI, "DcrB-related protein", "RHS repeat domain-containing protein"
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 73-77, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-13%, all S; the branch's families: "Ail/Lom family outer membrane beta-barr…", gpJ, "tail assembly protein", "C40 family peptidase", "phage minor tail protein L"
   61 fork: nfrA S 72%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 32%
   62 fork: ybcH S 85% "DUF4434 domain-containing protein"
   63 fork: fimZ S 54%; also ompT S 34%, "hypothetical protein" S 22%
   64 fork: sfmF S 52%; also "hypothetical protein" S 22%, "hypothetical protein" S 21%
   65 fork: fimH S 47%; also ydcC S 35%
   66 variable: sfmD S 39%
   67 fork: fimC S 45%; also "hypothetical protein" S 11%
   68 fork: envY S 74%; also fimA S 47%
   69 variable: folD P 61%
   70 fork: ybcJ P 60% "ribosome-associated protein YbcJ"; also appY S 15%
   71 variable: ybcI P 57% "metal-dependent hydrolase"
   72 fork: cysS P 54%; also "tail fiber assembly protein" S 11%
   73 fork: ppiB P 49%
   74 fork: lpxH P 45%
   75 fork: purE P 41% "AIR carboxylase family protein"
   76 fork: purK P 36%
   77 fork: ybcF P 31% "amino acid kinase family protein"
   78 fork: ylbF P 26% "DUF2877 domain-containing protein"; also fdrA S 13%
   79 fork: ylbE P 21% "DUF1116 domain-containing protein"; also allD S 11%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): dpiB ATP-binding protein; citC adenylyltransferase/cytidyltransferase…; citE citrate (pro-3S)-lyase subunit beta; citG triphosphoribosyl-dephospho-CoA synthase; citT citrate/succinate antiporter CitT; ahpF FAD-dependent oxidoreductase; entH proofreading thioesterase EntH; entA SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreduct…; entE (2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl)adenylate synthas…; entC isochorismate synthase EntC; fepG iron chelate uptake ABC transporter fam…; cusF Cu(+)/Ag(+) efflux RND transporter peri…; cusC Cu(+)/Ag(+) efflux RND transporter oute…; cusR copper response regulator transcription…; cusS Cu(+)/Ag(+) sensor histidine kinase; purE AIR carboxylase family protein; purK ATP-grasp domain-containing protein; citR LysR substrate-binding domain-containin…; tssI bacteriophage T4 gp5 trimerisation doma…; ompT omptin family outer membrane protease O…; ydcC ISAs1 family transposase; fimA type 1 fimbrial major subunit FimA; fdrA acyl-CoA synthetase FdrA; allD ureidoglycolate dehydrogenase
